data.name: Dash_Reco_Member_Expiring
data.value: High number of members expiring this week — launch an urgency-based renewal campaign via SMS/email with a limited-time discount.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Member_GenderImbalance
data.value: Significant gender imbalance detected — consider targeted marketing, women-specific classes, or referral incentives for the underrepresented segment.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Member_RetentionLow
data.value: Active retention is below 60% — introduce a loyalty program, check-in rewards, or a mid-term checkup call to reduce churn.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Member_Healthy
data.value: Healthy member base with steady growth. Focus on referral programs and community events to accelerate acquisition.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Att_WideVariance
data.value: Wide variance between peak and slow days — offer off-peak discounts or weekday-only memberships to flatten traffic and improve member experience.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Att_NearCapacity
data.value: Gym is near capacity right now. Consider capacity planning, off-peak incentives, or expanding floor hours to prevent overcrowding.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Att_LowUtilization
data.value: Daily utilization is below 40% of active members — run engagement campaigns, challenges, or free trial weeks to bring members back to the gym.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Att_Healthy
data.value: Attendance patterns are healthy. Maintain momentum with monthly challenges and member spotlights to keep engagement high.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Memb_HighChurn
data.value: Churn rate exceeds 30% — implement a retention workflow: 7-day-before-expiry reminder, reactivation offer at expiry, and a win-back campaign for cancelled members.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Memb_Concentration
data.value: Heavy concentration on one plan — introduce tiered upgrades or bundle options to diversify. Cross-sell premium features to top-plan members.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Memb_HighFrozen
data.value: Frozen memberships are high — reach out to understand why. Offer flexible re-activation incentives or temporary plan downgrades to retain them.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Memb_Healthy
data.value: Membership health is stable. Focus on upselling active members to higher tiers and launching seasonal promotions to grow new sign-ups.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Rev_OutstandingHigh
data.value: Outstanding payments exceed 20% of total revenue — automate payment reminders at 3, 7, and 14 days overdue. Consider late fees or prepay discounts to improve collection.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Rev_Concentration
data.value: Revenue is heavily dependent on one plan — diversify with tiered pricing, add-on services (PT, nutrition, classes), and bundle upgrades to reduce risk.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Rev_Declining
data.value: Revenue is declining month-over-month — analyze churn reasons, review pricing competitiveness, and launch a limited-time promo to re-engage lapsed members.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Rev_FreezeImpact
data.value: Freezes are costing significant revenue — consider offering a lower-cost 'pause' plan instead of full freeze, or a credit system to retain cash flow.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Rev_Healthy
data.value: Revenue is on a solid trajectory. Focus on increasing AOV through premium upgrades, add-ons, and multi-month prepay incentives.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Sub_LowRenewal
data.value: Renewal rate is critically low — audit the member experience at renewal touchpoints, offer a 'renew early' discount, and implement an automated reminder sequence starting 2 weeks before expiry.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Sub_FreezeImpact
data.value: Freezes are costing {0} in lost revenue and '{1}' has the lowest renewal rate. Review pricing and value perception for this plan, and offer a temporary downgrade option instead of freeze.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Sub_ManyExpiring
data.value: Over 10 subscriptions expiring within 7 days — deploy an urgent SMS/email campaign with a time-sensitive offer to maximize renewals before they lapse.

data.name: Dash_Reco_Sub_Healthy
data.value: Subscription health is stable. Drive growth by promoting multi-month prepaid plans (higher lock-in) and referral rewards that give both parties a free month.
